Title: DOMPurify: IN_PLACE hook removal leaves a detached subtree executable, causing XSS
Description: During `IN_PLACE` sanitization, a hook that removes an element can leave that element's detached descendants executable. A descendant image can retain its attacker-provided `onload` handler and fire after `sanitize()` returns, even though the returned root is clean and the image remains disconnected from the document.
